song.name: The Fall of Ravenspire
song.plot: The Legion of Souls overruns the ancestral ruins of Ravenspire in Nythoria. Seraphina watches her home burn; the invasion of Nythoria is complete. The Era II destruction — distinct from the Era III "Fall of Nythoria" (~230 AGD) when Seraphina conquers Malakar.
song.analysis: New song, written lore-first. POV: Seraphina (or Seraphina + Valen), first person — the song where home is lost. Anchors: Ravenspire (ancestral ruins), Nythoria, the Legion of Souls, the Shadow-Kin, ash, what the Void took. This is the Era II invasion/fall-of-Nythoria beat — the Legion's destruction, kept distinct from the Era III "Fall of Nythoria" event (~230 AGD, Seraphina conquering Malakar). No crossing to Eldoria (later), no Rift, no Anya, no founding anything, no "Queen". Structure: Verse 1 → Chorus → Verse 2 → Chorus → Bridge (grief) → Chorus → Outro. Slow, mournful build; 8-10 syllable lines. Suggested Suno direction: tragic, cinematic — choir over mournful strings, heavy but slow, emotional peak.

section.name: Verse 1
section.reworked: I watched the Legion crest the ancient wall, And Ravenspire burned beneath the blackened sky. The stones my people carved began to fall, And with them every hope I held inside.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: Ravenspire falls, the ashes rise, The home I knew is lost tonight. Nythoria weeps beneath the Void, And all that's left is what I hold.

section.name: Verse 2
section.reworked: The souls of those I loved are marching now, Conscripted into ranks I cannot stop. I lift my blade against the hollow crowd, And watch the legacy of ages drop.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: Ravenspire falls, the ashes rise, The home I knew is lost tonight. Nythoria weeps beneath the Void, And all that's left is what I hold.

section.name: Bridge
section.reworked: What did the dark take from me, But every face I swore to keep? If nothing else survives this night, Let it be this — the grief I keep.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: Ravenspire falls, the ashes rise, The home I knew is lost tonight. Nythoria weeps beneath the Void, And all that's left is what I hold.

section.name: Outro
section.reworked: Ash on the wind... Ash on the wind... Ravenspire falls.
